'''Kur Ha'rangir''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] leader of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. He was [[Lane Vizla]]'s rival. He led the remnants of the [[Hidden Chain]] forces on [[Ruhnuk]] after the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]], aiming to uncover [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] on the planet.<ref name="Iron" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
When Kur threatens to destroy the Basilisk droids as he makes his escape, players are given the option to either defuse the bombs or pursue Kur. Neither is a light side or dark side choice. Choosing to defuse the bombs saves the droids from destruction, but Kur will manage to flee. Pursuing Kur causes the lab to be destroyed, along with the Basilisk droids, and Kur is left injured outside the entrance, allowing him to be easily killed.<ref name="Iron" />
